parts.notes: The first edition's colophon is NonCommercial and says no party may sell the work or its derivatives, so an app only links to it. It contradicts the project home page's blanket 'each text carries CC BY-SA' line, which is why only the second edition is a show part.

notes: Only the 2nd edition (/multi2e/) is covered: its own colophon says CC BY-SA 4.0. The 1st edition (/multi1e/) is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (see parts), so the home page's statement that each text carries BY-SA does not hold for it; take the edition's own colophon, not the home page. The candidate's address /multivariable/ returns 'Page not found'. Not checked: individual figures, photographs and the interactive WeBWorK exercises (run on a separate server, problem code not read). No separate terms-of-use page was found on activecalculus.org. The bank's agents don't read it and nothing from it goes into the bank.
